summary: Verified the BLOCKER fix for Qoyod settings dropdowns. Backend: 4/4 new catalog-proxy tests pass + full Qoyod regression suite 280 passed / 2 skipped (no failures) — branches & taxes short-circuit to {ok:true, unsupported:true, data:[], qoyod_ui_path:'/settings/<resource>'} without hitting Qoyod, accounts faithfully passes through {ok:false, unsupported:false, error.code:'qoyod_unauthorized', status_code:401} for the current merchant key (which lacks accounts.read scope). Frontend: /integrations/qoyod/settings now exposes select-branch and select-tax as <input type='text' list='...'> with datalist autocomplete; the unsupported hints (data-testid='branches-unsupported-hint' / 'taxes-unsupported-hint') are visible in Arabic and reference 'Qoyod → الإعدادات → الفروع/الضرائب'. Typed '1234' (branch) and '5678' (tax), clicked 'حفظ الإعدادات', reloaded the page → values persisted correctly via PUT /settings. The Pipeline/Make.com code was NOT touched, matching the user's explicit constraint.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py _UNSUPPORTED_CATALOGS is the correct, minimal shape — short-circuits BEFORE any HTTP call, returns deterministic JSON. Verified by test_unsupported_proxies_do_not_hit_qoyod and by sub-second cURL latency.

Accounts endpoint correctly preserves faithful pass-through: returns 200 at HTTP level with ok:false and structured error — operator sees status_code:401, endpoint:'GET /accounts', clear Arabic message 'مفتاح API غير صالح أو منتهي'. Right contract.

QoyodSettings.jsx: switching from <select> to <input type='text' list='...'> is the right move when the upstream API doesn't expose the catalog. The yellow hint banner with Arabic copy and a path to the Qoyod UI gives operators an actionable next step.

2 unrelated console warnings about Recharts ('width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0') and 2 unrelated 400 responses observed during navigation — neither from the Qoyod settings flow.
All 282 Qoyod tests pass (was 273 at iter-260 baseline; +4 new catalog-proxy tests + earlier additions). No regression to Pipeline/state-machine/eligibility/legacy-adapter.

success_rate.backend: 100% (280 passed + 2 skipped, 0 failed across all test_qoyod_*.py)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (input type, datalist binding, hint visibility, Arabic content, type+save+reload persistence cycle)

seed_data_creation: Set tenant Qoyod settings: default_branch_id='1234', default_tax_id='5678' on the admin tenant for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog proxies for branches/taxes are intentionally short-circuited (Qoyod 2.0 doesn't expose them). UI presents text inputs + Arabic hints + datalist. Backend contract: {ok:true, unsupported:true, data:[], code:'qoyod_catalog_not_exposed', message:<arabic explanation>, qoyod_ui_path:'/settings/branches' or '/settings/taxes'}. Accounts is real but typically returns 401 in Preview because the merchant key lacks accounts.read scope — that pass-through is the contract, not a bug. Frontend testids: select-branch, select-tax, branches-unsupported-hint, taxes-unsupported-hint. Save button text: 'حفظ الإعدادات'. PUT /api/settings persists default_branch_id and default_tax_id as free-form strings. 282 Qoyod pytest tests must continue to pass.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug already fixed by main agent before this iteration. This testing iteration verified the fix end-to-end (backend contract + frontend UI + persistence) and confirmed no regression.
